description: This file provides utility functions for extracting GPS metadata from image files using the exifread library, including converting GPS coordinates to decimal degrees and creating GeoJSON point features.

methods.name: Optional[float] _dms_to_decimal(dms, ref)
methods.description: Converts DMS (degree-minute-second) GPS coordinates to decimal degrees, considering the reference (N/S/E/W).

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[float],Optional[float],Dict[str,Any]] extract_gps_from_bytes(data: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts latitude, longitude, and basic EXIF metadata from image bytes.

methods.name: dict make_geojson_point(lat: float, lon: float)
methods.description: Creates a GeoJSON point dictionary from latitude and longitude.

ctags.name: extract_gps_from_bytes
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_gps_from_bytes(data: bytes) -> Tuple[Optional[float], Optional[float], Dict[str, Any/
